observations: Torah #180 has exactly 5 bechina edges forming one single connected component. All 5 nodes (מלכות, צדק, רגלים, ממון, דין) are fully integrated into Package 1 (מָעוֹת וּמַלְכוּתָא קַדִּישָׁא). There is no sub-domain within the dataset that would warrant a second independent package. Potential domain candidates were examined: (A) A 'Binah / three hands' domain is present in the source text but these concepts have no bechina edges in the dataset for Torah #180 — they are eitza/structural elements, not bechina-parallel members. They would need bechina edges to form a package. (B) The divine names (שם מב, שם אקיק, שם יקו, שם מה) form an interesting cluster in the source text but are never equated to the core concepts through bechina language; they are instruments (eitza), not parallel aspects. (C) There is no evil mirror package in this Torah — the teaching presents judgments (דינין) as a neutral/spiritual reality that is sweetened rather than as an evil force to be defeated. The absence of evil-mirror polarity is consistent with the topic (pidyon as a spiritual remedy mechanism) which does not feature a sitra-achra counter-narrative. The Torah is one of the shortest in Likutay Moharan, presenting a single tight chain of equivalences and their practical/mystical resolution.
